ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of funds in the Minnesota fraud investigation, including the use of federal funds and the potential for money laundering.
questions: How were federal funds used in the Minnesota fraud investigation?
Were there any instances of money laundering?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we may be able to uncover a larger scheme involving the misuse of federal funds and the potential for money laundering. This could lead to a more comprehensive understanding of the fraud and potentially identify additional perpetrators.

ideas.title: The Impact of the Government Shutdown on Fraud Investigations
ideas.description: Examine the potential impact of a government shutdown on fraud investigations, including the potential for delayed or suspended investigations.
questions: How would a government shutdown affect fraud investigations?
What are the potential consequences of delayed or suspended investigations?
ideas.insight: A government shutdown could have significant impacts on fraud investigations, potentially leading to delayed or suspended investigations. This could allow perpetrators to continue their fraudulent activities, causing further harm to victims and the public.
